raw: [name="Arturia"]Ah... they can't feel our emotions either, and are anxious over it. They desperately want to share theirs, but they can only resort to brute force.

raw: [name="Arturia"]Like an infant yet to grow a halo—no matter what they want to express, they can only cry and grab at their parents' sleeves... Yes, they are our people, just too immature.

content: Like an infant yet to grow a halo—no matter what they want to express, they can only cry and grab at their parents' sleeves... Yes, they are our people, just too immature.

raw: [name="Federico"]The Law grants an infant a halo when it speaks its first word because language represents rationality's awakening.
